messages:
Sara (PM): Rollout heartbeat — starting progressive ramp for feature-flag `kv-cache-multitenant` to 10% in prod. Post your 3-line async: What you did / Blockers / Today. I'll monitor surface metrics (errors / p50 / CPU).
DeployBot: [automated] Rollout started for flag kv-cache-multitenant — target 10% (slice: green).
Alice (Platform Eng): What I did: ran smoke + warmup on canary hosts, validated model shard binding. Blockers: saw one reroute test fail (reroute-service 502), digging logs. Today: will triage reroute & run quick canary-only load.
Marco (SRE): What I did: Observed heap churn on pool-a during ramp; not critical. Blockers: none blocking rollout yet. Today: I'll watch eviction rate and adjust oom-killer thresholds if needed. :eyes: Dash: https://metrics.redwood/prod/dash/kv-evict
Eve (QE): What I did: kicked off regression suite against canary traffic. Blockers: sequence gen flaky in one test (seed mismatch). Today: isolating test and capturing traces.
Alice (Platform Eng): Quick repro for reroute 502:
```bash
curl -H 'x-ff:kv-cache-multitenant: true' -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.prod.internal/route | jq .
```
Returns 502 with upstream error id. Added logs: `upstream_id=svc-reroute-11`.
Tomas (Infra): Scheduled a brief config bump for HPA min replicas +1 to reduce cold starts. Will deploy in ~25m. No downtime expected.
DeployBot: Canary progress: 2% -> 10% complete (elapsed 12m). No alerting thresholds breached.
Marco (SRE): Noted a 0.2% increase in 5xx but tied to reroute. If reroute fix goes in, we should be green.
Eve (QE): Quick note: regression suite shows throughput drop ~7% on canary hosts under sustained load. Might be related to caching policy changes. Logging more metrics and attaching traces to the ticket.
Alice (Platform Eng): Pushed a small config tweak to reroute timeout (2500 -> 3500ms) to reduce 502s; monitoring now.
Sara (PM): Thanks — plan: hold at 10% for 45m while we validate p50 & 5xx. If no regressions, ramp to 30% at +1h. Call out if you need me to pause the ramp. :thumbsup:
Marco (SRE): ACK. I'll escalate if 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 5m.
DeployBot: Next ramp scheduled in 1h unless canceled. Rollout metadata: owner@sara, change-id=ch-9483.
